fieldValues.title: Third party using SRS in Semantic records
fieldValues.summary: A group outside the programme that uses the SRS specification and its tools for its own records, and needs those records to keep their meaning exactly, whatever tool or client reads them.
goals: Build on the spec and its tools without depending on our internals
Keep meaning in its records, not in a client
Keep what a tool does not understand
jobs: Adopt the spec and its tools
Choose tools that preserve its records
Rely on conformance when a tool changes
fieldValues.needs: A spec and tools that honour their contracts, meaning defined once in the records, and every tool round-tripping what it does not understand.
